snippet.title: Kingdomino Steam Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The official Kingdomino board game is landing on Steam on November 20th! The Spiel des Jahres 2017 winner now has a faithful digital adaptation on Steam. Can you conquer the lands?

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3029180/Kingdomino/
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kingdomino-the-board-game/id6468810215
Android: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kingdomino-the-board-game/id6468810215
Official Kingdomino Discord: https://discord.com/invite/jKSnQ6WuCF
Kingdomino Digital Edition: https://meeplecorp.com/kingdomino/
